svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Half section and half elevation of a plain, unfluted column with a simple moulded base and capital, carrying a plain entablature. Source: Proportions after Giacomo Barozzi da Vignola, Regola delli cinque ordini d’architettura (Rome, 1562). Simplified; drawn by Project Exodus.
svg.text: SOURCE: Proportions after Giacomo Barozzi da Vignola, Regola delli cinque ordini
d’architettura (Rome, 1562). Simplified; drawn by Project Exodus.
